title: A first sign-in from a joomlart.com template page keeps utm_medium product-page instead of turning into other
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (no stand, no database, no listener needed) run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/sign-in-source.test.mjs
S2: Read the summary lines `pass` and `fail`, and the test line whose name starts with `signInSource reads only the four utm keys`.
expect: The run exits 0 and its summary reads `fail 0`.

`signInSource reads only the four utm keys, holds medium to the closed set, and is null when empty` passes: MEDIUMS equals email, blog, demo, site, forum, product-page, and the query `provider=JoomlArt&open=ja-diner&utm_source=joomlart&utm_medium=product-page&utm_content=two-ways` reads as source joomlart, medium product-page, content two-ways.
evidence: Production 23/10/2026: a customer signed in from https://www.joomlart.com/joomla/templates/ja-diner (utm_medium=product-page, utm_content=two-ways) and was recorded as medium other, shown as Channel Other on /ops/signals.
fence: signInSource holds medium to MEDIUMS; anything outside still becomes other. Unit test only: not a proof that the Signals screen draws the orange bucket.
